blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per operating system (OS) for the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Module in the Zscaler Client Connector app.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.8.2.1 for Windows

blocks.text: Rolls back an enhancement that tripped a "process allowlist" in certain edge case scenarios.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.8.1.67 for Windows

blocks.item: Adds a Decline button to the remote script’s end user notification configuration.
Enhances Modern Standby status detection and allows ZDX to pause active network probes to ensure an accurate status and prevent misleading failures.
Enhances security for Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module.
Enhances TCP capabilities in Cloud Path probe configuration.
Supports FIPS 140-3 compliance standards and upgrades OpenSSL library to version 3.5.5.
Upgrades the integrated SQLite database engine to version 3.53.1 to improve performance, security, and stability.
Fixes an issue where the CPU usage of top processes on the Device Health graph is inconsistent with the actual CPU usage values.
Fixes an issue where the external proxy hops are incorrect in Cloud Path.
Fixes an issue where the Wi-Fi retransmission rates and values are reported incorrectly.
Fixes an issue where the Web probe fails to process HTTP responses from specific websites due to an excessive amount of HTTP link headers.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.7.0.76 for Windows

blocks.text: Enhances security for Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module by:

blocks.item: Improving memory management, inter-process communication (IPC) validation, cryptographic checks, and HTTP redirect handling.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.7 for Windows

blocks.item: Addresses incomplete Network Interface data in Device Profile and Device Stats on Windows.
Fixes an issue where there are missing Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge metrics on the Cloud Path.
Fixes Cloud Path VIP selection to use the tunnel-detected VIP in IPSec/GRE scenarios.
Fixes policy downloader to follow system proxy and retry via external proxy on PAC/TPG timeouts.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.6.2.15 for Windows

blocks.item: Corrects the Learn More button display in the Notifications tab on corporate devices.
Enhances proxy handling by retrying with the system-configured external proxy when direct TPG connections time out.
